findings.scenario: The fixture polls a nonblocking listener then uses read_request, which expects blocking accepted-stream reads. Platforms that inherit listener mode can yield WouldBlock before request bytes arrive; the selected Linux lane does not establish a failure here.
findings.rationale: Normalize the accepted stream to blocking as the same-tree daemon and ComputerUse fixture already do. This preserves every behavioral assertion and makes the actual-request oracle independent of platform accept inheritance. Include this small correction in the separately required producer-lock input extension; it does not initiate a round by itself.
findings.change: Call set_nonblocking(false) on each accepted stream before timeout/read_request setup.
findings.evidence_kind: source-based portability finding; no executed failure claimed
findings.next_review: Fresh R6 delta plus affected fixture and existing producer/capture contracts; original eighteen BXR paths retained and one necessary lock path added.

structure_terminal_assessment: APPROVE with one P3 non-blocking fixture portability finding
